chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Knowledge is testimony when its possessor is wronged."

key_terms.اَلْعِلْمُ: knowledge; direct awareness of a matter
key_terms.شَهَادَةٌ: testimony; evidence presented to establish a claim
key_terms.صَاحِبُهُ: its possessor; the one who holds that knowledge
key_terms.مَظْلُوماً: wronged; subjected to injustice or oppression

ai.seo_question: Can personal knowledge count as testimony when someone has been wronged?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person's knowledge may serve as testimony when that person has been wronged. It reflects a juridical principle concerning the probative value of direct knowledge in establishing a claim.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"Knowledge is a testimony when its possessor is wronged."
